tasks.label: frontend: format check
tasks.command: docker compose exec frontend yarn format:check

tasks.label: frontend: lint
tasks.command: docker compose exec frontend yarn lint

tasks.label: frontend: typecheck
tasks.command: docker compose exec frontend yarn type-check

tasks.label: backend: format check
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python -m ruff format --check .

tasks.label: backend: import check
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python -m isort --check-only .

tasks.label: backend: lint
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python -m ruff check .

tasks.label: backend: typecheck
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python -m mypy .

tasks.label: backend: tests
tasks.command: docker compose exec backend python -m pytest -q
